title: nephrodium apiciflorum
intro: Nephrodium apiciflorum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium apiciflorum include its diuretic and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of urinary retention and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium apiciflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
